messages:
deploybot: release-check FAILED — keystore path mismatch between staging and prod. blocked promotion for release 2026-03-20/slot-42

maria: looking... can you paste the diff?

deploybot: detected env KMS_KEYSTORE_PATH differs:
```
STAGING: KMS_KEYSTORE_PATH: s3://redwood-keystore/keys/
PROD:    KMS_KEYSTORE_PATH: s3://redwood-keystore/keys
```

aj: oof trailing slash. Which services read it strictly? runtime and token-encryptor will append filenames so trailing slash matters.

sam: we hit this before — policy code expects no trailing slash, but the staging helm values generator normalizes with a slash. likely helm chart value in staging has `keystorePrefix: "/keys/"` vs prod `"/keys"`.

lee: current release is pinned to image tag `redwood/runtime@sha256:abcd1234` — we can hotfix chart only. suggestion: patch chart values in staging to match prod, rerun preflight then promote. canary OK if we run a small traffic slice.

maria: risk? change window in 2h. If we wait for infra to cut a change window might push past QA signoff.

aj: prefer single-line fix: update deploy-check to normalize trailing slashes (strip suffix) — but that's a code change and shouldn't be in this release. so patch helm values in staging and mark follow-up ticket to update check.

sam: agree. rollback not needed if we fix staging value; but if staging pin differs from prod we should still re-run integration tests. I'll apply patch and post the helm override here.

sam: PATCH (helm values override):
```
keystore:
  path: s3://redwood-keystore/keys
```

deploybot: preflight re-run scheduled.

deploybot: preflight PASSED — can proceed with canary in next 5m :thumbsup:

maria: I'll update release notes: "Fixed staging keystore prefix parity; prevented trailing-slash mismatch causing keystore resolution errors. Follow-up: normalize keystore path in deploy-check (ENG-1567)."

lee: tagging release with `release/2026-03-20-keystore-path-fix` and retaining the image pin.

aj: logging follow-up in #eng-devex for deploy-check change.

sam: done. moving to canary. :rocket:
